title: CBI files first chargesheet in Reliance Home Finance Limited case; cites ₹3,526 crore loss
description: The agency has registered seven First Information Reports against Reliance Communications Limited (RCOM), Reliance Home Finance Limited (RHFL), Reliance Commercial Finance Limited (RCFL) and Reliance Telecom Limited (RTL) based on complaints received from various public sector banks and LIC
